Library versions and build settings, still self containing and static builds, no dependency to runtime distributable):
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


zlib-1_3_1 notes (zlib 1.3.1):
------------------------------
- For static library I needed to undefine ZLIB_WINAPI, otherwise the symbol conventaion mismatches
  (missing symbols on linking). Can be checked with "dumpbin /LINKERMEMBER zlib1_vs2022_32.lib | findstr gz",
  replace gz with your missing symbol
- Built with contrib project file in zlib-1_3_1\contrib\vstudio\vc17


libpng notes (libpng 1.6.50):
-----------------------------
- Build with project file in lpng1650\projects\vstudio
- Adopt path in zlib.props for the zlib headers
- Do NOT use the zlib built by libpng, it does only define symbols used by libpng



plib notes:
-----------
- Release build had debugging info, switched that off to avoid missing pdb warnings in the TORCS build
- patched ul.h, because it did not check if WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN was already set
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#  define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif

64 bit build, added x64 target, check generated libs with:
- dumpbin /directives fnt.lib | findstr DEFAULTLIB
- dumpbin /headers fnt.lib | findstr machine


freeglut-3.6.0:
---------------
- build with 
- cmake -B build32 -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A Win32 -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=install32 -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT" -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG="/MTd" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG="/MTd" -DFREEGLUT_BUILD_DEMOS=OFF -DFREEGLUT_BUILD_TESTS=OFF
- cmake --build build32 --config Release
- cmake --install build32 --config Release
- Check if "/MT" option was taken: dumpbin /dependents install32\bin\freeglut.dll
- Should NOT contain CRUNTIME140.dll, api-ms-win-crt-heap-l1-1-0.dll, etc.
- Applied hack from https://github.com/freeglut/freeglut/issues/73
diff --git a/freeglut/freeglut/src/mswin/fg_main_mswin.c b/freeglut/freeglut/src/mswin/fg_main_mswin.c
index 6d286e7..2e7bed6 100644
--- a/freeglut/freeglut/src/mswin/fg_main_mswin.c
+++ b/freeglut/freeglut/src/mswin/fg_main_mswin.c
@@ -731,7 +731,7 @@ static LRESULT fghWindowProcKeyPress(SFG_Window *window, UINT uMsg, GLboolean ke
     fgState.Modifiers = INVALID_MODIFIERS;

     /* SYSKEY events should be sent to default window proc for system to handle them */
-    if (uMsg==WM_SYSKEYDOWN || uMsg==WM_SYSKEYUP)
+    if ((uMsg==WM_SYSKEYDOWN || uMsg==WM_SYSKEYUP) && wParam!=VK_F10)

- 64 bit build with:
- cmake -B build64 -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=install64 -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT" -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG="/MTd" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG="/MTd" -DFREEGLUT_BUILD_DEMOS=OFF -DFREEGLUT_BUILD_TESTS=OFF
- cmake --build build64 --config Release
- cmake --install build64 --config Release
- dumpbin /headers freeglut.dll | findstr machine -> "8664 machine (x64)"


libogg-1.3.6:
-------------
- rmdir /S /Q build32 install32 (cleanup, just if you built before)
- cmake -B build32 -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A Win32 -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=install32 -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT /O2 /DNDEBUG" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT /O2 /DNDEBUG" -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON
- Check lib dependencies, see freeeglut above: dumpbin /dependents install32\bin\libogg.dll

- 64 bit build with:
- cmake -B build64 -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=install64 -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT /O2 /DNDEBUG" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT /O2 /DNDEBUG" -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON
- cmake --build build64 --config Release
- cmake --install build64 --config Release
- dumpbin /headers install64/bin/ogg.dll | findstr machine
- dumpbin /dependents install64/bin/ogg.dll


libvorbis-1.3.7:
----------------
- rmdir /s /q build32 install32
- cmake -B build32 -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A Win32 -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=install32 -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -DOGG_INCLUDE_DIR=..\libogg-1.3.6\install32\include -DOGG_LIBRARY=..\libogg-1.3.6\install32\lib\ogg.lib -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT /O2 /DNDEBUG" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT /O2 /DNDEBUG"
- cmake --build build32 --config Release --target INSTALL
- dumpbin /dependents install32\bin\vorbis.dll
- dumpbin /dependents install32\bin\vorbisfile.dll

- 64 bit build with:
- cmake -B build64 -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=install64 -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -DOGG_INCLUDE_DIR=..\libogg-1.3.6\install64\include -DOGG_LIBRARY=..\libogg-1.3.6\install64\lib\ogg.lib -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT /O2 /DNDEBUG" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT /O2 /DNDEBUG"
- cmake --build build64 --config Release
- cmake --install build64 --config Release


freealut (https://github.com/vancegroup/freealut, master from 2025-10-03)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
- cmake -B build32 -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A Win32 -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=install32 -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DBUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DBUILD_TESTS=OFF -DOPENAL_INCLUDE_DIR=..\openal-soft-1.24.3-bin\include\AL -DOPENAL_LIBRARY=..\openal-soft-1.24.3-bin\libs\Win32\OpenAL32.lib -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT /O2 /DNDEBUG"
- cmake --build build32 --config Release
- cmake --install build32 --config Release
- Modified alut.h for now, added "AL/..." in includes and defined "#define ALUT_BUILD_STATIC". Will be replaced with SDL, good enough for now.

- 64 bit build with:
- cmake -B build64 -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=install64 -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DBUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DBUILD_TESTS=OFF -DOPENAL_INCLUDE_DIR=..\openal-soft-1.24.3-bin\include\AL -DOPENAL_LIBRARY=..\openal-soft-1.24.3-bin\libs\Win64\OpenAL32.lib -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE="/MT /O2 /DNDEBUG"
- cmake --build build64 --config Release
- cmake --install build64 --config Release
